stem_book: A paratrooper jumps from an aeroplane and opens a parachute after 2 s of free fall and starts decelerating with 3 m/s². At 10 m height from ground, while descending with the help of parachute, the speed of paratrooper is 5 m/s. The initial height of the aeroplane is ____ m. (g = 10 m/s²) (a) 62.5 (b) 92.5 (c) 20 (d) 82.5
